visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a beige sweatshirt and pants sits on a small white stool at a light wood coffee table, holding a drawing and looking distressed. A woman in a red hoodie sits opposite him, leaning toward him in an open, modern living room with hexagonal wall shelves and a white sofa. (2) The woman gestures toward the boy's drawing while he reacts with visible frustration, his mouth downturned. A grey cat lies quietly on the floor in the background. A toddler in a grey onesie enters from the right, approaching the table. (3) The woman points at the paper and interacts with the toddler while maintaining focus on the older boy. Markers, drawing tools, and various household objects are scattered on the table. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the indoor space. (4) The boy eventually calms down, stands up from his stool, and begins to move rhythmically. The woman smiles and offers a high-five, which the boy enthusiastically returns. The camera remains at a static, wide eye-level angle for the duration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, strained crying from a child dominates the mix, repeating a single phrase multiple times with heavy vocal tension. Background is a quiet indoor room tone. (2) A calm, resonant adult female voice enters, speaking with a steady, low-arousal cadence and clear articulation to soothe the child. (3) Soft incidental thuds and plastic rustling sounds are heard as objects are moved on a table. No background music is present. (4) The female voice rises in pitch with a melodic, engaging contour, explaining a concept. The child's voice gradually shifts from distressed to a neutral, conversational tone. (5) Indistinct, soft babbling from a toddler occurs in the background. (6) The child's voice eventually becomes rhythmic and excited, sounding positive and energetic. A distinct percussive hand-slap sound concludes the sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a parenting moment focused on emotional education, showing a mother successfully teaching her child how to reframe negative thoughts and manage frustration through creative play and positive self-talk.
